name: 地下泉池洞穴
coordinate_contract: Local integer XYZ; entrance and interior are player FEET coordinates.
design_translation: 17x13x19 actual volume; concept dimensions are approximate.
North central entrance, T-shaped dry stone route, supported bridge with rails, connected spring pools, real cascade, embedded columns, dripstone, hanging vines, empty supply barrels.
Vanilla amethyst and warped fungus represent the blue crystals and cyan fungi; no custom colored lighting, particles, entities, loot or trading.
